description_en: Verifies the ownership of a specified domain name
description_zh: 调用VerifyDomainOwner对域名归属权进行校验
kebab_example: aliyun cdn verify-domain-owner --domain-name example.com --verify-type dnsCheck --region cn-hangzhou
name: VerifyDomainOwner

parameters.help_en: The domain name of which you want to verify the ownership. You can specify only one domain name
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The verification method. Valid values:

- **dnsCheck**: by DNS record

- **fileCheck**: by verification file
parameters.help_zh:
校验方式，取值：

- **dnsCheck**：DNS验证。
- **fileCheck**：文件验证
parameters.name: verify_type
